title: AS2 compiler: instanceof operator not implemented
description: The AS2 compiler in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts does not handle the instanceof binary operator (e.g. x instanceof MyClass). In AVM1, ActionInstanceOf (opcode 0x54) performs this check: push(x), push(MyClass), ActionInstanceOf leaves a boolean on stack. Check if it's already handled; if not, add a case in the BinaryExpr visitor for operator 'instanceof'.
